## Review

Neovisni reviewer dodaje komentar:

```
Agent-Review: <runtime>:<slot>:reviewer
Review-Head: <sha>
Review-Verdict: PASS
```

Za `critical` PR QA dodaje:

```
QA-Agent: <runtime>:<slot>:qa
QA-Head: <sha>
QA-Verdict: PASS
QA-Scope: <adversarialni scenariji>
```
